proposal.expected_benefit: This change ensures that audit compliance is not assumed but actively enforced, reducing the risk of security gaps due to misconfigured or incomplete controls.
proposal.problem: The defense assumes that audit and compliance controls are already robust and correctly implemented, which may not be the case. This assumption could lead to a misallocation of resources and potential security gaps.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement explicit and enforceable audit compliance mechanisms that are directly tied to the replay protection logic. This includes ensuring that audit status is explicitly checked and enforced before any financial execution, with clear failure conditions and remediation steps.
proposal.title: Explicit Enforcement of Audit Compliance
verification_tests: Verify that audit status is explicitly checked before financial execution
Test that compliance decisions cannot override audit requirements
Validate that replay protection mechanisms are directly tied to audit compliance checks
